data.body_html:
Planning a Marbella boat rental weather November 2031? With average highs of 21°C, calm seas and fewer crowds, November is one of the best-kept secrets for a luxury yacht charter on the Costa del Sol. Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús daily, with all charters including a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks and insurance. Whether you want a 2-hour sunset cruise or a full 8-hour day at sea, we have the perfect boat for your November escape.

Marbella Weather in November 2031: What to Expect

November in Marbella brings mild Mediterranean weather. Daytime temperatures hover around 21°C, dropping to 14°C in the evenings. Sea temperatures are around 18°C – refreshing but not cold. You’ll enjoy about 7 hours of sunshine daily, with only 4–5 rainy days in the month. Winds are light, and average wave height stays below 1 metre, making it a smooth ride for all boat sizes.

Why November Is Ideal for a Boat Rental in Marbella

Summer crowds have gone, meaning quieter marinas, more availability and often lower prices. The calm sea conditions make November perfect for families, couples or small groups who want a relaxed, private charter. You can anchor off Cabopino, cruise the Golden Mile or head to Estepona without the summer bustle. Plus, the light is gorgeous for photos – soft and golden over La Concha mountain.

Our Fleet for November 2031 Charters

All our boats depart from Puerto Banús and are available year-round. Here’s a quick overview of options:

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749/2h → €2,299/8h. Perfect for up to 11 guests. Includes skipper, drinks, snacks, fuel and VAT.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax): €4,719 minimum 4h with a free jet ski. Ideal for larger groups wanting speed and luxury.
  • Other boats (Azimut 58, Ferretti 94, Pershing 46, etc.): Pricing on request via WhatsApp. We’ll tailor a quote to your group size and itinerary.

All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden extras.

Popular November Itineraries from Puerto Banús

With calm seas, you can explore more. Here are three recommended routes:

  • Marbella Coastline Cruise: Head east past the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina, anchor off Cabopino for lunch, then return. 4 hours is enough.
  • Estepona & Cala del Faro: Sail west to Estepona’s charming old town and the quiet Cala del Faro cove. A full-day (8h) trip lets you enjoy both.
  • Sotogrande & Gibraltar Views: For longer charters, cruise to Sotogrande’s luxury marina and see Gibraltar in the distance. Best with a larger boat like the Mangusta 80.

What to Wear and Bring for a November Boat Trip

Pack layers. A light jumper or jacket is useful for sea breezes. Sunscreen (SPF 30+) is still essential – the sun is strong even in November. Sunglasses, a hat and a camera are must-haves. If you plan to swim, a wetsuit top makes the 18°C water more comfortable. We provide towels on request.

Booking Tips for November 2031

November is low season, so availability is good. However, weekends and sunny days book quickly. We recommend contacting us via WhatsApp at least one week in advance. Let us know your preferred date, group size and any special requests (e.g., catering, jet ski, paddleboard). We’ll confirm the best boat and pricing within hours.
